SELECT IF( COUNT(1) = 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN check_in_time IS NULL OR check_out_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0, 1, 0 ) FROM t_attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND attendance_date = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_plan WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND plan_type = 3 AND status IN (0, 1, 3) AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date < CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(attendance_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, DATE_FORMAT(attendance_date, '%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(1) AS value FROM t_attendance_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND attendance_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY attendance_date ORDER BY attendance_date ASC

SELECT d.dept_name AS name, COUNT(e.id) AS value FROM t_department d LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.dept_id = d.id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name, d.sort_order HAVING COUNT(e.id) > 0 ORDER BY d.sort_order ASC, d.id ASC
